title: Positive: two-person messaging works live on desktop and phone (10/10)
steps: ALLOW_E2E_SEED=1 E2E_MESSAGING_PASSWORD=<random> npx playwright test --project=messaging-desktop (and messaging-phone)
expected: Live delivery, replies, reactions, edit, pin, delete, forward, requests, blocking, groups, channels, offline resend.
actual: All 5 scenarios pass on Desktop Chrome and Pixel 7 emulation. iPhone and iPad projects need WebKit, which is not available in this sandbox (UNVERIFIED).
